flexibook.book.empty.title: Empty Book
flexibook.book.empty.body: This book has no pages yet.
flexibook.book.demo.title: FlexiBook Field Guide
flexibook.book.demo.intro: This demo book showcases adaptive layout, translation-aware reflow, rich text tags, images, safe links, and in-book search.
flexibook.book.demo.feature.adaptive: Auto scale and optional two-column layout for long content
flexibook.book.demo.feature.i18n: Content stores translation keys — switch language and reopen to reflow
flexibook.book.demo.body1: Unlike vanilla written books, FlexiBook does not freeze text into fixed 14×114 pages. Opening the book resolves translations, measures glyphs with the active font, and builds pages on the fly.
flexibook.book.demo.body2: When a language uses wider glyphs (for example many CJK characters), the layout engine gently reduces scale before adding pages, so the book stays readable.
flexibook.book.demo.markup_sample: This paragraph was appended via tag markup.
flexibook.book.demo.font_sample: This run uses the minecraft:alt font.
flexibook.book.demo.outro: Use AdaptiveBookBuilder or FlexiBookAPI from your mod to ship your own guides. Happy writing!
